question: Who was Player of the Match in the final of U-19 World Cup cricket, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is Raj Bawa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raj Bawa won Player of the Match in the 2022 U-19 Cricket World Cup final.**
 
• **Cricket player Raj Angad Bawa** was born on November 12, 2002, in India.
 
• He took a wicket with his first delivery when he played his first game of first-class cricket for Chandigarh in the **2021–22 Ranji Trophy **in February of that year.
 
• He has participated in tournaments for the **India national under-19 cricket team**, including the **ACC Under-19 Asia Cup in 2021 and the ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup in 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **James Rew**

 
 
• **​Cricket player James Edward Kenneth Rew **was born in England on January 11, 2004.
 
• **Rew** was selected to play for the **County Select XI** in a three-day encounter against India in July 2021 while they were on a tour of **England**. On July 20, 2021, **Rew** participated in the game for the first time.
 
• On August 1, 2021, he played for** Somerset in the 2021 Royal London One-Day Cup,** making his List A debut.
 
 
 
• **Yash Dhull**
 
 
• ​​ **Cricket player Yash Vijay Dhull **was born in India on November 11, 2002.
 
• In February 2022, during the **2021–22 Ranji Trophy**, he made his first-class cricket debut for the** Delhi cricket team**, opening the batting and hitting two hundreds.
 
• He has competed for the **India national under-19 cricket team**, serving as captain in both of **India's championship** teams at the **2021 ACC Under-19 Asia Cup and the 2022 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup.**
 
 

64:T
